# GitHub Issue Labels

The following labels can be used to organise issues in the Selvage project.

| Label | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `bug` | Reports unexpected or incorrect behaviour |
| `enhancement` | Suggests a new feature or improvement |
| `documentation` | Documentation-related changes |
| `testing` | Test-related issues or improvements |
| `security` | Security-related concerns |
| `frontend` | Frontend-related issues |
| `backend` | Backend-related issues |
| `database` | Database or migration-related issues |

Labels help keep project issues organised and make it easier to identify
the type of work required.
